title: Jesus Rodriguez
html:
Jesus Rodriguez holds a Master in Information Technology Management, CISCO CCNP and CCNA, and is one of the first people using SIP Express Router (SER) in business environment. During past years, he dedicated the efforts to build Voztele service, with Kamailio (OpenSER) as key component, being as well actively involved in the Kamailio (OpenSER) environment, packaging for FreeBSD, participating and giving presentations about project at various world wide events.

Another important contribution to the VoIP/SIP spectrum coming out of his team is WeSIP Java SIP Servlet application server with associated Kamailio (OpenSER) module SEAS.

Contact: www.voztele.com
